title: ClipForge Evidence Manifest Timestamp Provenance & Chronology Reconciliation

reported_inconsistency.apparent_gap: +3 hours 15 minutes future-dated relative to contemporaneous context
reported_inconsistency.nature_of_issue: Provenance inconsistency due to naive local-to-UTC serialization

container_environment.measurement_method: Compared docker exec clipforge_backend date -u with host datetime.now(timezone.utc)

forensic_event_chronology.event: Full-viewport responsive screenshots captured by Playwright
Responsive walkthrough manifest written by run_responsive_audit.mjs
Modal workflow screenshots captured by test_modals_audit.mjs
Evidence manifest initialized on host disk

definitive_root_cause_analysis.mechanism: The author authored the manifest at approximately 03:25:00 AM local time (IST). When writing the ISO-8601 string, the author naively appended the UTC 'Z' designator to their local clock time ('2026-11-03T03:25:00Z') instead of recording the true UTC time ('2026-11-02T21:55:00Z') or the timezone-explicit local time ('2026-11-03T03:25:00+05:30').
definitive_root_cause_analysis.verdict: RECONCILED. The evidence manifest was never future-dated in reality; it was created at 03:21-03:25 AM IST (21:51-21:55 UTC on 2026-11-02), exactly contemporaneous with the crawl that took place between 03:30 and 03:43 AM IST. The apparent +3h15m gap was a pure timezone representation artifact produced by conflating local IST time with UTC Zulu time.

audit_tooling_remediation.standard_enforced: All future tooling must generate timezone-aware UTC timestamps using datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat() or explicitly append local offset (+05:30). Naive string concatenation of 'Z' is strictly prohibited.
audit_tooling_remediation.monotonic_clock_rule: Elapsed durations must be calculated using time.monotonic() rather than subtracting wall-clock datetime instances.
